evidence.title: Coding agent quickstart
evidence.finding: Terminal and browser share a conversation; forks can switch harnesses.

evidence.title: Collaborate
evidence.finding: Self-hosted server mediates read/edit collaboration; sandbox execution requires server configuration.

evidence.title: Polly
evidence.finding: Polly delegates Claude implementation and Codex review with inspectable child sessions.

evidence.title: Omnigent Mobile
evidence.finding: Android supports managed server URLs; docs say iOS has no equivalent yet and will use the same key when it lands.

evidence.title: Omnigent Desktop app
evidence.finding: macOS/Linux/Windows desktop shells serve full UI. Native notifications, dock badge and embedded browser. On macOS and Linux (not Windows), SSH connection starts a remote background host, then disconnects SSH; host keeps outbound server connection.

evidence.title: Omnigent Mobile
evidence.finding: Native iOS/Android shells and full mobile web UI connect to reachable server. iOS notifications foreground-only; org-preset server URLs available on Android but still future on iOS.

evidence.title: Omnigent Web UI
evidence.locator: Session management; projects; worktree branches; export
evidence.finding: Sessions persist across server restarts; projects group sessions; worktree launch options, diffs/files/inline comments and JSONL session export/import exist. Projects are grouping, not a native issue tracker.

evidence.title: Omnigent Harness support
evidence.finding: Claude Code/Codex fully supported; Cursor/OpenCode/Pi maintained; Grok via ACP. Direct and native-TUI modes differ; plain model providers do not establish harness support.

evidence.title: Omnigent Pair programming
evidence.finding: Read/Edit session shares; Edit teammates send prompts and answer approvals. Only owner changes agent/MCP/permission mode; raw shell owner/admin only. Fork copies history independently.

evidence.title: Omnigent Shared server
evidence.finding: Self-hosted server persists sessions/artifacts/catalog in SQLite/Postgres; separate local/remote hosts execute agents. Cloud sandbox providers allow laptop-independent work.

evidence.title: Omnigent Auth and SSO
evidence.finding: Invite-only built-in accounts or OIDC/header SSO. Admin manages membership/policies/sharing; owner/Edit/Read permissions scope sessions. First admin setup must be completed by operator.

evidence.title: Omnigent Usage telemetry
evidence.finding: Anonymous server usage telemetry defaults on; opt out with OMNIGENT_ANALYTICS=0, DO_NOT_TRACK=1 or telemetry:false. Prompts/files/credentials excluded according to vendor.

evidence.title: Omnigent Polly tutorial
evidence.finding: Shipped Polly orchestrator breaks a task into sub-tasks delegated to different agents (Claude Code and Codex in the example) in parallel Git worktrees, with cross-vendor review of each PR. Agents panel shows live sub-agent status, conversations, files and terminals.

evidence.title: Omnigent Omnigent README
evidence.finding: Claude Pro/Max and ChatGPT subscriptions via official CLIs, API keys and compatible gateways. YAML agents include MCP/local function/subagent tools. Policy stacks at session/agent/server scope; caps and approval gates.

evidence.title: Omnigent Scheduled tasks
evidence.finding: Recurring scheduled agent sessions use persistent task definitions, a server scheduler and a REST API. Minimum interval is ten minutes on connected hosts or continued sessions and one hour for new sandbox sessions. Overlapping fires of a task are skipped; no automatic retry or missed-fire replay.

evidence.title: Omnigent Policy reference
evidence.finding: Declarative policies allow/deny/ask actions; max tool calls, cost caps and thresholds. OS sandbox uses Linux bwrap/macOS seatbelt; plain sessions are not sandboxed by default. Generic agent-start DENY/ASK does not block launch.

evidence.title: Omnigent Pull request workflow
evidence.finding: Session PR associations persist server-side; description, checks, comments, changed files and diffs stay on and are served by the host provider integration. Incomplete data is flagged; linked request summaries remain when host offline; head/base revisions are validated before diffs are returned.

evidence.title: Omnigent Application license
evidence.finding: Application repository is Apache-2.0.

evidence.title: Omnigent v0.21.0 release
evidence.finding: 2026-11-05 release adds PR list/checks/merge UI, inline GitHub review conversations and SSH host connection.

evidence.title: Omnigent README
evidence.locator: 'Use any model' bullet; credential types table (API key / Subscription)
evidence.finding: Says Omnigent works with any model, using a first-party vendor API key or an existing Claude Pro/Max or ChatGPT subscription. It also offers cost-budget policies.

evidence.title: Omnigent homepage
evidence.finding: Says Omnigent is open source under Apache 2.0. The page shows no price, plan or pricing page.

evidence.title: Omnigent coding-agent quickstart
evidence.finding: Says the setup runs locally and you can deploy a server to share sessions. No hosted plan or price is mentioned.

evidence.title: omnigent-ai/omnigent LICENSE (Apache-2.0)
evidence.finding: The Apache License 2.0 grants a perpetual, worldwide, no-charge, royalty-free copyright license to use and reproduce the code.
